subject.title: fix(nostr): keep profile imports as cancellable drafts (AI-assisted)

question: May the shipped Nostr `autoMerge: true` import behavior lose its persistence side effect immediately, or does this plugin HTTP contract require a versioned transition?
rationale: The safe UX requires eliminating hidden persistence, but the route behavior has shipped and may have consumers beyond the Control UI; repository policy treats plugin API behavior changes as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Adopt draft-only imports now
options.body: Approve the non-mutating contract, verify mixed-version UI handling, and require direct browser proof before merge.

options.title: Require a transition contract
options.body: Pause merge until the route has an explicit deprecation or versioned response plan that does not restore hidden config mutation.

recommendation.title: Adopt draft-only imports now
recommendation.body: Approve the non-mutating contract, verify mixed-version UI handling, and require direct browser proof before merge.
